services.Title: Google Drive
services.Intro: Google Workspace file storage and sharing
services.Description: Google Workspace storage is focused on application use and collaborative file sharing.
services.Example Use: Collaborative sharing for classwork or with users at other universities.
services.Cost: Free up to specific thresholds. University does not provide additional storage on g.syr.edu accounts.
services.Capacity:
- Active Students & Staff: 10 GB
- Active Faculty & Instructors: 60 GB
- Shared Drives: 20 GB Quota (requests for exceptions can be raised)
services.Access and Collaboration: Files and folders within My Drive can be shared ad-hoc for collaboration with SU and non-SU users. Owner controls sharing options, including edit and view rights; file and folder-level controls are available.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: Confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
- Restricted: Academic data. Research and bulk data is strongly discouraged.
services.Durability: High. Google built-in backup and recycle bin policies apply. Data restore can be admin-initiated for 25 days after the trash is emptied, recycle bin is user-controlled with 30-day retention.
services.Availability: Medium. Google runs redundant infrastructure, but no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.
services.Technical Complexity: Low. Google use model is ease of use and collaboration.
services.Contact: ITS Core Infrastructure CDI Application team. Contact Support

services.Title: GitHub (SU Enterprise)
services.Intro: Web platform to store, manage, and share code and files
services.Description: A platform built on Git that provides hosting for repositories, collaborative tools, issue tracking, CI/CD integration, and project management.
services.Example Use: Hosting and collaborating on open-source or private software projects, tracking changes in code, and managing issues.
services.Cost: Free for faculty and students.
services.Capacity: GitHub recommends repositories stay under 1 GB and strongly recommends staying under 5 GB. Individual files over 50 MiB raise a warning and files over 100 MiB are blocked; larger files can be tracked with Git Large File Storage. No process in place to purchase additional quota or higher limits. About large files on GitHub
services.Access and Collaboration: Repositories can be made public or private. Shared access to users onboarded on the SU GitHub Enterprise account.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: Confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
- Restricted: Academic data. Research and bulk data is strongly discouraged.
services.Durability: High. Git retains the full revision history of every file in the repository. GitHub does not back up repositories for you; mirror clones must be made separately.
services.Availability: Medium. GitHub manages its own infrastructure; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.

services.Title: Microsoft OneDrive
services.Intro: Cloud storage for individual use or sharing with specific individuals
services.Description: OneDrive is the default storage location for personal files at SU. Saving to OneDrive on an SU-managed machine is as simple as saving to Documents or Desktop. OneDrive lets you store and protect your files, share them with others, and access them from anywhere on all your devices.
services.Example Use: Personal file storage. Online, real-time collaboration and sharing of specific files with users in and out of SU.
services.Cost: Free up to specific thresholds
services.Capacity: 500 GB on university-provided Microsoft 365 suite. Staff and Faculty can request more storage from their IT support.
services.Access and Collaboration: SU requires that sharing invitations be sent to an email address and requires that invitees not using a @syr.edu email address be able to receive an access code at their email address to access any shared files.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
- Allowed with special configuration: HIPAA-regulated data HIPAA Compliance Details
services.Durability: High. 30-day file version history, a 93-day recycle bin, and Files Restore, which rolls the whole OneDrive back to any point in the last 30 days.
services.Availability: Medium. Microsoft manages redundancy across its data centers; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.
services.Contact: ITS Help Desk at 315-443-2677, Email Support

services.Title: Microsoft SharePoint
services.Intro: Cloud storage for sharing with a broad audience
services.Description: SharePoint Communications sites are for one-way information sharing. SharePoint Team sites for collaboration with groups are best created using Microsoft Teams. Only content authors create and modify files. Visitors can only view files.
services.Example Use: Create portals or subject-specific sites such as an HR site for employee benefits.
services.Cost: Free up to specific thresholds
services.Capacity: 500 GB on university-provided Microsoft 365 suite. Staff and Faculty can request more storage from their IT support.
services.Access and Collaboration: Can include non-SU users. Owner controls sharing options, including edit and view rights.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: Confidential or restricted/high-risk data, Export-Controlled information.
- Allowed with special configuration: HIPAA-regulated data Refer to the Microsoft HIPAA compliance documentation
services.Durability: High. 30-day file version history and a 93-day recycle bin, with a second-stage site collection recycle bin for items removed from the first.
services.Availability: Medium. Microsoft manages redundancy across its data centers; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.

services.Title: Microsoft Teams
services.Intro: Cloud storage for team collaboration with online meetings and chat
services.Description: Microsoft Teams is a workspace for real-time collaboration and communication, meetings, file, and app sharing. Edit documents together at the same time while tracking your changes—no more emailing revisions back and forth. Ask for feedback in real-time, poll the audience, and make decisions faster as a team.
services.Example Use: File storage for departments and groups. Online, real-time collaboration and sharing of files and folders with users in and out of SU.
services.Cost: Free up to specific thresholds
services.Capacity: 500 GB on university-provided Microsoft 365 suite. Staff and Faculty can request more storage from their IT support.
services.Access and Collaboration: Can include non-SU users. Owner controls sharing options, including edit and view rights.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: Confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Files are stored in SharePoint, with 30-day file version history and a 93-day recycle bin.
services.Availability: Medium. Microsoft manages redundancy across its data centers; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.

services.Title: Microsoft Shared Libraries
services.Intro: Cloud storage for group and project collaboration
services.Description: Collaborative document libraries in SharePoint for teams to store, organize, and share files.
services.Example Use: Department-level shared storage for projects or internal documents.
services.Cost: Free up to specific thresholds
services.Capacity: 500 GB on university-provided Microsoft 365 suite. Staff and Faculty can request more storage from their IT support.
services.Access and Collaboration: Can include non-SU users. Owner controls sharing options, including edit and view rights.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: Confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Document libraries are stored in SharePoint, with 30-day file version history and a 93-day recycle bin.
services.Availability: Medium. Microsoft manages redundancy across its data centers; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.

services.Title: AWS Elastic Block Store
services.Intro: Storage for use with Amazon EC2
services.Description: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) provides persistent block storage volumes for use with Amazon EC2 instances in the AWS Cloud. EBS volumes are automatically replicated to provide high availability and durability. EBS offers high performance and the ability to scale your usage up or down quickly while paying only for what you use.
services.Example Use: Storing data files to be accessed by a single Amazon EC2 server.
services.Cost: Cost dependent on volume type, replication, and other services used.
services.Capacity:
- No practical file size limit.
- Up to 64 TiB per volume.
- No practical limit to the number of files (costs incurred).
services.Access and Collaboration: End-user access control to the content of EBS volumes is implemented by the EC2 instance to which an EBS volume is attached. Access and management of EBS volumes themselves are controlled by AWS IAM (Identity and Access Management).
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data (contact AWS Elastic Block Store for more information), HIPAA-regulated data Refer to the AWS HIPAA compliance documentation.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Point-in-time snapshots can be scheduled with Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager or AWS Backup, and snapshot data is replicated across all Availability Zones in the Region. AWS does not create snapshots for you.
services.Availability: Medium. An EBS volume exists in a single Availability Zone and has no native cross-zone replication; restoring from a snapshot is recovery rather than failover.

services.Title: AWS Elastic File System
services.Intro: Storage for use with multiple Amazon EC2 instances
services.Description: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) provides simple, scalable file storage for use with Amazon EC2 instances in the AWS Cloud. EFS grows and shrinks automatically, so your applications have the storage they need, when they need it. Multiple EC2 instances can access an EFS file system at the same time. EFS provides high performance, availability, and durability.
services.Example Use: Storing data files to be shared among multiple servers for conducting analyses.
services.Cost: > $1000/TB/Year
services.Capacity:
- 47.9 TiB file size limit.
- No overall limit (costs incurred).
- No practical limit to the number of files.
services.Access and Collaboration: Access to EFS volumes by servers is controlled by AWS network access control lists and security groups. Servers mounting EFS volumes are responsible for end-user access control.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data (contact AWS Elastic File System for more information), HIPAA-regulated data Refer to the AWS HIPAA compliance documentation.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Natively integrated with AWS Backup. File systems created in the console are backed up automatically by default, daily with 35-day retention.
services.Availability: High. EFS Replication keeps a destination file system in sync across Regions, with documented failover and failback and a 15-minute recovery point objective.

services.Title: AWS Glacier
services.Intro: Cloud-based archival storage
services.Description: Amazon S3 Glacier is a set of secure, durable, and extremely low-cost cloud storage classes for data archiving and long-term backup. Instant Retrieval serves archives immediately. Flexible Retrieval restores them in 1-5 minutes (Expedited), 3-5 hours (Standard), or 5-12 hours (Bulk). Deep Archive, the lowest-cost class, restores within 12 hours (Standard) or 48 hours (Bulk).
services.Example Use: Storing an archival copy of a static dataset when the actively used, primary copy is stored elsewhere.
services.Cost: < $500/TB/Year
services.Capacity:
- 5 TB file size limit.
- No overall limit (costs incurred).
- No practical limit to the number of files.
services.Access and Collaboration: Extensive control using AWS IAM (Identity and Access Management).
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data (contact AWS Glacier for more information), HIPAA-regulated data AWS HIPAA Compliance Documentation.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. S3 bucket versioning preserves and restores every version of an object, and lifecycle rules control retention.
services.Availability: High. Cross-Region and Same-Region Replication are configured per bucket, and replication rules can target the Glacier storage classes directly.

services.Title: AWS S3
services.Intro: Flexible, scalable object storage
services.Description: Scalable object storage service for a variety of use cases.
services.Example Use: Making a large dataset available for public download. Private file sharing with versioning and replication for a widely distributed team.
services.Cost: Up to $1000/TB/Year. Cost dependent on storage class, replication, and other services used.
services.Capacity:
- 5 TB file size limit.
- No overall limit (costs incurred).
- No practical limit to the number of files.
services.Access and Collaboration: Extensive control using AWS IAM (Identity and Access Management).
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data (contact AWS S3 for more information), HIPAA-regulated data AWS HIPAA Compliance.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Bucket versioning preserves and restores every version of an object, including recovery from accidental deletion or overwrite.
services.Availability: High. Cross-Region and Same-Region Replication are configured per bucket; two-way replication supports failover through Multi-Region Access Points.

services.Title: Dropbox
services.Intro: Cloud-based file sharing for individually owned data
services.Description: Dropbox is a cloud-based file sharing option for individual data storage. The individual owner is the only one with full control over the space, but links to the data can be created and then shared with others.
services.Example Use: File storage, sharing, and collaboration across devices.
services.Cost: Free (2 GB) or paid plans starting at $9.99 / month for 2 TB storage (billed annually; $11.99 billed monthly)
services.Capacity: Varies by plan: 2 GB free, 2 TB on Plus, and from 3 TB (Standard) or 15 TB (Advanced) for teams.
services.Access and Collaboration: Supports real-time collaboration and sharing with external users.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data Dropbox HIPAA Overview.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. File version history is retained for 30 days on Basic and Plus, 180 days on Professional and Business, and 365 days on Business Plus and Enterprise.
services.Availability: Medium. Dropbox manages its own redundancy; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.

services.Title: Box
services.Intro: Cloud-based storage and collaboration service
services.Description: Box is an online file sharing and cloud content management service that works on PCs, Macs, mobile and tablet devices and provides access to files from any location for collaboration with other University users or external parties.
services.Example Use: Secure sharing of sensitive data and team collaboration.
services.Cost: Free (10 GB) or paid plans starting at $10/month.
services.Capacity: Varies by plan, up to unlimited for Business plans. 250 MB file size limit for free plan.
services.Access and Collaboration: By inviting existing Box users to folders, or by sending shared links. Owner controls sharing options, including edit and view rights; file and folder level controls available.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data Box HIPAA Compliance.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Prior file versions are retained per plan: 1 on the free plan, 10 on Personal Pro, 50 on Business and 100 on Enterprise, with unlimited versions on higher tiers.
services.Availability: Medium. Box manages its own redundancy; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.

services.Title: Wasabi
services.Intro: Flexible and scalable object storage in the cloud
services.Description: Affordable, high-performance cloud storage that is S3-compatible, often used as an alternative to AWS S3.
services.Example Use: Backup storage for businesses, media archiving, disaster recovery, and data lakes.
services.Cost: Pay-as-you-go service starts at $7.99/TB/Month.
services.Capacity: Unlimited, scalable cloud storage. A 1 TB monthly minimum charge and a 90-day minimum storage duration apply to pay-as-you-go accounts.
services.Access and Collaboration: Data can be accessed through S3-compatible APIs, integrated with applications, and shared securely.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data (requires a signed Business Associate Agreement with Wasabi before any PHI is stored) Wasabi Business Associate Agreement.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Object versioning retains prior versions, and Object Lock can hold objects immutable for a fixed retention period.
services.Availability: High. Object Replication copies objects to one or more destination buckets, within or across accounts. Paid accounts only.

services.Title: Zenodo
services.Intro: Open access repository for research data
services.Description: Zenodo is a research data repository that provides open access to datasets, publications, and other scholarly content. It supports data sharing across disciplines and ensures long-term preservation. Every upload is assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI) to make them citable and trackable.
services.Example Use: Publishing datasets, code, or preprints with DOI assignment.
services.Cost: Free to upload and free to access. Zenodo has no upper data limits, but each record is limited to 50 GB and 100 files.
services.Capacity: Zenodo has no upper data limits, but each record is limited to 50 GB and 100 files.
services.Access and Collaboration: Zenodo collaboration and sharing features allow you to share individual record drafts with other users and communities. Records can have open or closed access.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information
services.Durability: High. Files are versioned, backed up to tape nightly, and held as multiple replicas across CERN data centres in Geneva and Budapest, with MD5 checksums verified regularly.
services.Availability: Medium. Zenodo manages its own replication; no replication or failover options are configurable by the depositor.
services.Contact: OSPO at ospo@syr.edu or visit Zenodo.

services.Title: Dryad
services.Intro: Open access repository of research data
services.Description: Dryad is an open data publishing platform and a community committed to the open availability and routine re-use of all research data.
services.Example Use: Archiving datasets for journal publications.
services.Cost: Data Publishing Charge scales with dataset size: $150 up to 5 GB, $180 up to 10 GB, $520 up to 50 GB, and higher tiers above that. Submissions sponsored by a partner organization are covered up to 10 GB, with a Large Dataset Fee above that. Fee waivers are available for authors without funds.
services.Capacity: Individual files should not exceed 10 GB. Limit of 2 TB per data publication uploaded through the web interface.
services.Access and Collaboration: Open access shared with the public. Some data may have access restrictions due to privacy concerns, ethical considerations, or copyright issues. Authors can apply restrictions to certain datasets.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Data files are replicated to several geographic locations and stored with SHA-256 checksums verified on roughly a 60-day cycle; metadata is backed up nightly and published datasets are versioned.
services.Availability: Medium. Dryad manages its own replication; no replication or failover options are configurable by the depositor.

services.Title: Figshare
services.Intro: Open-access repository for research data, publications, and multimedia
services.Description: Figshare is a web-based repository designed to enable researchers to store, share, and disseminate their research outputs, including datasets, figures, videos, and other types of multimedia. It provides an open-access platform where researchers can upload and share a wide range of research materials to make them publicly available.
services.Example Use: Sharing datasets, figures, or media files with persistent identifiers.
services.Cost: Free plan provides 20 GB of storage per user. Additional storage can be purchased through Figshare Plus.
services.Capacity: Unlimited public storage once items are published. The free plan provides 20 GB of private storage per user for work held back before publication; more private storage can be purchased through Figshare Plus. Up to 500 items per account, each with its own DOI (Digital Object Identifier).
services.Access and Collaboration: Open access with DOI for citation. Restricted access for selected individuals or groups. Share via links or create groups.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Files and metadata are backed up nightly to Figshare-managed AWS S3 buckets with versioning enabled for immediate restore, and published items carry file and metadata version control.
services.Availability: Medium. Figshare states that its S3 content is region bound and that cross-region replication is still being explored; nothing is configurable by the depositor.

services.Title: OSF.io
services.Intro: Open platform to support research and enable collaboration.
services.Description: OSF.io, or the Open Science Framework, is an online platform that enables researchers to transparently plan, collect, analyze, and share their work throughout the entire research life cycle.
services.Example Use: Publishing datasets, code, or preprints with DOI assignment.
services.Cost: Free
services.Capacity: Capacity of 5 GB for private projects and 50 GB for public projects. File size limit of 5 GB. Can integrate with other storage management services (e.g., Amazon S3, Dropbox, Github, OneDrive).
services.Access and Collaboration: Public projects are open access with optional DOI. Collaborators and contributors can be added for projects, registrations, or preprints. Each contributor has their own permission level (i.e., Administrator, Read+Write, and Read), each with different responsibilities and privileges.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High
services.Availability: High

services.Title: QDR
services.Intro: Archive for storing and sharing digital data (and accompanying documentation)
services.Description: The Qualitative Data Repository (QDR) is a dedicated archive for storing and sharing digital data (and accompanying documentation) generated or collected through qualitative and multi-method research in the social sciences and related disciplines. QDR provides leadership and training in—and works to develop and publicize common standards and practices for—managing, archiving, sharing, reusing, and citing qualitative data. Through these efforts we aim to expand and improve the use of qualitative data in the production and evaluation of research, and in teaching.
services.Example Use: Storing data from structured, semi-structured, or unstructured interviews; focus groups; oral histories (audio/video recordings; transcripts; notes/summaries; questionnaires/interview protocols).
services.Cost: Free for SU faculty and students. Depositors without an institutional membership are charged curation fees (usually $500 to $1,500 depending on volume of files to be deposited).
services.Capacity: Contact QDR before uploading large amounts of data or individual files larger than 2 GB.
services.Access and Collaboration: Public, restricted, and private data sharing. Researchers can control access levels and collaborate with team members or reviewers through managed permissions.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Allowed with special configuration: FERPA-protected data, confidential or restricted/high-risk data.
- Not Allowed: HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Primary storage on AWS S3, with on-site backups at Syracuse University and a BagIt preservation package in Google Cloud Coldline on the opposite coast. Dataverse versions every published change.
services.Availability: Medium. QDR manages its own redundancy; no replication or failover options are configurable by the depositor.
services.Contact: QDR Website. Reach out by email to qdr@syr.edu

services.Title: NFS Home Directory
services.Intro: Storage for Research Computing Analyses
services.Description: Storage exclusively for the SU research computing clusters. This directory is ideal for storing datasets, scripts, and other files necessary for computational workflows.
services.Example Use: Storage for research data computed on the OrangeGrid or the Zest clusters.
services.Cost: At no cost to SU affiliates
services.Capacity: No per-user quota is published. Contact Research Computing to discuss storage options for multi-terabyte datasets. OrangeGrid storage specifications
services.Access and Collaboration: Private to the owning NetID. The home directory is available on the submit and login nodes, and is mounted on compute nodes while a job runs.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data.
- Not Allowed: Confidential data, HIPAA-regulated data, Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: Medium. Research Computing does not publish a snapshot or backup policy for home directory storage. Contact researchcomputing@syr.edu to confirm what protection is in place before relying on it.
services.Availability: Medium. No replication or failover options are documented or configurable by the user.
services.Contact: Reach out by email to researchcomputing@syr.edu

services.Title: G:/ Drive
services.Intro: Storage for group and project collaboration
services.Description: Offers a collaborative directory for teams to store, organize, and share files.
services.Example Use: Department-level shared storage for projects or internal documents.
services.Cost: At no cost to SU affiliates
services.Capacity: 60 TB; Inquire if more is needed
services.Access and Collaboration: Access is limited to authorized users with an active SU affiliation. Authorized users can have a mixture of Read+Write, and Read permissions. Contact your school specific IT department to add/remove authorized users to a given shared G:/ drive.
services.Data Allowed:
- Allowed: Public data, sensitive/moderate risk data, confidential data, HIPAA-regulated data.
- Not Allowed: Export-Controlled information.
services.Durability: High. Campus file servers retain up to 21 instances of your drives within the last 30 days, restorable through Windows Previous Versions.
services.Availability: Medium. ITS manages the campus file servers; no replication or failover options are configurable by the user.
services.Contact: Contact your school specific IT department. Find Contact Info here
